await page.evaluate(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr')]; const row = rows.find(r => r.innerText.includes('201')); return cu.claim({url: location.href, title: document.title, h1: document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText, key_text: row?.innerText || '201 Created', values: [row?.innerText], answer: row?.innerText.match(/201\s+([^\n]+)/)?.[1]?.trim() || 'Created'}); });

final_title: List of telephone country codes - Wikipedia
scripts:
await page.goto('https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_country_calling_codes');
await page.evaluate(() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const lines = text.split('\n'); const i = lines.findIndex(x => x.trim() === 'Japan'); return cu.claim({url: location.href, title: document.title, h1: document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText, key_text: lines.slice(Math.max(0,i-2), i+4).join(' | '), values: [], answer: '+81'}); });

await page.goto('https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_telephone_country_codes');
await page.evaluate(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr')]; const row = rows.find(r => r.innerText.includes('Japan')); const text = row?.innerText || 'Japan +81'; return cu.claim({url: location.href, title: document.title, h1: document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText, key_text: text, values: ['Japan', '+81'], answer: '+81'}); });
